### A Promise to Live By
Author: John Piper
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/a-promise-to-live-by
Passage: Isaiah 41:10
Points:
- Isaiah 41:10 serves as a lifelong anchor verse for facing daunting and intimidating life situations.
- God addresses believers directly in the personal first person to assure them of His immediate aid.
- The sweeping promise of divine help is versatile enough to fit every trial and circumstance.
- God's righteous character guarantees He will act zealously for His own glory and uphold His people.
- Because of Jesus Christ, every believer can claim this promise with complete gospel assurance.

### Immanuel, God With Us
Author: Alice Matagora
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-december-25-2023.html
Passage: Isaiah 41:10
Points:
- Feelings of emotional exhaustion and feeling overwhelmed can leave us feeling spiritually unsteady and slipping.
- God extends His steadying hand to uphold and strengthen us when our own resources run dry.
- The ultimate fulfillment of this promise is Jesus coming as Immanuel, God with us.
- Rather than rebuking our human helplessness, Christ responds with tender mercy and His indwelling Spirit.
- Believers are never left to wander alone through seasons of pain, fatigue, or uncertainty.

### How God Deals With Our Anxiety
Author: Jennifer Slattery
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wholly-loved/how-god-deals-with-our-anxiety-wholly-loved-august-28.html
Passage: Isaiah 41:10
Points:
- Simplistic religious clichés often fall short because they overlook the physical side of anxiety and distress.
- When His children experience deep emotional turmoil, God does not chastise them, but draws near in mercy.
- The Lord strengthens conflicted hearts by speaking comfort and walking with us step by step.
- Biblical peace embraces the whole person, integrating spiritual faith alongside necessary physical rest and practical support.
- God lovingly holds our fragmented and hurting parts as He leads us toward freedom and wholeness.

### The Fear of Becoming First-Time Parents
Author: Vivian Bricker
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-couples-devotional/the-fear-of-becoming-first-time-parents-crosswalk-couples-devotional-september.html
Passage: Isaiah 41:13
Points:
- Major life milestones and unfamiliar responsibilities can stir up acute fear and worst-case thinking.
- Letting fear dictate major decisions robs believers of peace and the good gifts God desires to give.
- God promises to grasp our right hand personally, pledging His active support along the unfamiliar path.
- Bringing worries directly to God in prayer breaks the grip of catastrophic thoughts and restores courage.
- Focusing on love and resting in God's helping hand replaces anxiety with confidence in His guidance.
